title: INC-1043 Authentication Gateway postmortem
content: INC-1043 postmortem for Authentication Gateway, published 2026-04-16T16:00:00Z. Impact window 2026-04-16T02:00:00Z to 2026-04-16T03:21:00Z. Customer impact: login and token refresh requests failed with TLS handshake errors. During triage one team proposed a new identity provider policy rejecting old OAuth scopes; another proposed DNS propagation sending users to a retired gateway. These conflicting preliminary hypotheses were rejected after checking INC-1043-LOGS and service metrics. Confirmed root cause: the public TLS certificate for auth.internal.example expired at 02:00 UTC because the renewal job had a disabled service account. Decisive evidence: openssl x509 reported notAfter=2026-04-16T02:00:00Z; gateway logs recorded certificate_expired for every failing handshake. Recovery and prevention: issued and installed a replacement certificate, re-enabled the renewal service account, and added 30-day expiry alerts. Follow-up owner is the Authentication Gateway on-call team. Evidence source IDs: INC-1043-REPORT, INC-1043-LOGS, INC-1043-RUNBOOK. This postmortem source ID is INC-1043-POSTMORTEM.
